svg.aria-description: Who owns what in Parcelpoint's catalog: 15 nodes, 16 connections. 15 entities of a Backstage catalog, framed by the group that owns them. An arrow says a component provides or consumes an API, or depends on another entity.
svg.font-family: pw-sans-i9odwjqm92, Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: Who owns what in Parcelpoint's catalog
svg.desc: Who owns what in Parcelpoint's catalog: 15 nodes, 16 connections. 15 entities of a Backstage catalog, framed by the group that owns them. An arrow says a component provides or consumes an API, or depends on another entity. Nodes: - Identity: Engineering (Group, department, Ana Costa) - Identity: Tracking team (Group, team, Mara Lindqvist, Tobi Adeyemi) - Tracking API (Service, in tracking), service - Carrier event worker (Service, in tracking), service - Tracking REST API (OpenAPI API, in tracking), gateway - Parcel events (AsyncAPI API, in tracking), gateway - Tracking database (Postgres) (Resource, database, in tracking), database - Carrier events (RabbitMQ) (Resource, queue, in tracking), queue - Identity: Labels team (Group, team, Priya Raman) - Label intake (Service, in labels), service - Label renderer (Service, in labels), service - Label requests (OpenAPI API, in labels), gateway - Label requests (Amazon SQS) (Resource, queue, in labels), queue - Label jobs (DynamoDB) (Resource, database, in labels), database - Label PDFs (Amazon S3) (Resource, s3-bucket, in labels), storage - Identity: Integrations team (Group, team, Jonas Weber) - Merchant dashboard (Website, in merchant-integrations), client - Webhook sender (Service, in merchant-integrations), service - Node SDK (Library, experimental, in merchant-integrations), service Connections: - Merchant dashboard to Tracking REST API: consumes - Webhook sender to Parcel events: consumes - Node SDK to Tracking REST API: consumes - Label intake to Label requests: provides - Label intake to Label requests (Amazon SQS): depends on - Label intake to Label jobs (DynamoDB): depends on - Label renderer to Label requests (Amazon SQS): depends on - Label renderer to Label jobs (DynamoDB): depends on - Label renderer to Label PDFs (Amazon S3): depends on - Tracking API to Tracking REST API: provides - Tracking API to Label requests: consumes - Tracking API to Tracking database (Postgres): depends on - Tracking API to Carrier events (RabbitMQ): depends on - Carrier event worker to Parcel events: provides - Carrier event worker to Tracking database (Postgres): depends on - Carrier event worker to Carrier events (RabbitMQ): depends on

g.text: Group, team, Mara Lindqvist, Tobi Adeyemi
